notes: Footnote printed below the table: '(A)- Performance of K&C Valley STP at Bengaluru, (B)- As per Example 8-2 & 8-5 of Wastewater Engineering-Metcalf & Eddy-4th Edition, NG-Not Given'.
The caption gives the average flow as '31 MLD' while the running text on the same page calls the same plant 'its 30 MLD capacity'. Both retained as printed; not reconciled.
Serial numbers are printed with a following full stop (1. to 18.) and are kept exactly.
Row 10 and row 16 carry no unit, and rows 12 and 13 are ratios (no unit). Cells are transcribed as printed, not completed.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page render and 300-420 dpi crops; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: All 18 numbered rows, both value columns and the printed footnote read from 300 dpi crops. NG values and decimals verified individually.
